plan.closeQuestion: What did this season carry away from Sandra's hands, and who noticed?

sources.name: Sandra Velazquez
sources.quote: I don't usually have seasonal health concerns—I'm pretty careful about staying active and eating right year-round. Maybe the Tribune should ask if this is based on actual doctor visits or just general neighborhood chatter.

sources.name: Ariana Lee
sources.quote: I've lived here long enough to know Sandra Velazquez doesn't just get seasonal sniffles—she's the type to power through a flu without missing a beat. The Tribune should ask what changed this year that made it noticeable enough to mention.
